Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologii energetice, Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Utilități
You have a passion for technology and want to make the world a greener place? 
 Join the forefront of energy transition with E.ON Software Development. As a professional services organization, we collaborate closely with our business units, providing pivotal services that accelerate E.ON's ambitious Digital Transformation strategy. 
 It’s on us to make new energy work! 
 Join E.ON’s central Software Distribution & Hardening (SDS/H) product team , developing secure, compliant, and highly automated cloud infrastructure solutions for application teams across E.ON.
 Help us build reliable and scalable automation for Virtual Machines and container-based workloads using modern cloud-native technologies such as Kubernetes and Crossplane .
 Your Role – meaningful & rewarding
 Solution Design: Collaborate with stakeholders and application teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. Design and implement solutions using modern technologies and engineering best practices, with a strong focus on security, automation, maintainability, and scalability. Contribute technical expertise and actively shape the evolution of the SDS/H product.
 Software Development & Automation: Develop and maintain secure, reusable, and scalable automation solutions, with a strong focus on PowerShell. Ensure high standards for code quality, testing, maintainability, and reliability, while continuously improving automation and reducing manual processes.
 Kubernetes & Platform Engineering: Develop and maintain Kubernetes-based solutions and automation. Work with Kubernetes resources, deployments, configuration, and security concepts. Integrate SDS/H services with E.ON’s central automation platform. Experience with Crossplane and Argo CD is a strong plus.
 CI/CD & Git Workflows: Develop and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, validation, security scanning, and deployment. Implement appropriate quality gates and automated checks throughout the development lifecycle. Work confidently with Git-based development workflows, including branching, merge requests, code reviews, and collaborative development.
 Your Profile – authentic & open-minded
Completed studies or training in the field of computer science or a comparable qualification.
Strong interest in working in an international, agile, and remote team, including monthly onsite meetings in Germany, with a mindset that embraces agile principles and collaboration.
High level of ownership and accountability, taking the lead on tasks and driving them to completion, while proactively contributing new ideas and continuous improvements rather than only executing assigned work.
 Our Benefits – smart & useful
 Enjoy flexibility: 
A stable work environment that offers you the flexibility to have a personal and fulfilling work rhythm.
Flexible benefits package – choose what suits you best, from gym memberships to holidays, meals, or shopping vouchers.
 Recharge your battery: 
25 vacation days to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Private medical insurance to support your well-being.
 Advance your development: 
Access to internal learning programs and online learning platforms to grow your skills and career.
 This is by far not all… We are looking forward to speaking with you about further benefits during the hiring process.
